sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention_items order by environment,issue

sections.title: Open changes
sections.sql: select * from change_queue where state in ('pending','approved') order by due_on

sections.title: Active flags
sections.sql: select * from flag_inventory order by environment,key

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,environment
sections.note: Local checks supporting a change-control policy, not a certification.
